name: Palm Heroes Vita
author: Cardas26
description: Palm Heroes (iO UPG, 2010) is a Heroes-of-Might-and-Magic-style strategy game for Windows Mobile. v1.05.3 was released as free by the developers in 2010. This port uses a custom built WinMobile loader to bring that version of the game to the PS Vita, including several optional enhancements.
